reruns_without_limit.gold_cypher: MATCH (n:Person)<-[r0:hasCastMember]-(m0:Movie),(n:Person)<-[r1:directedBy]-(m0:Movie) WITH DISTINCT n UNWIND n.country_of_citizenship AS prop RETURN DISTINCT prop
MATCH (n:Movie)-[r0:hasCastMember]->(m0:Person),(n:Movie)-[r1:directedBy]->(m0:Person) WITH DISTINCT n WHERE NOT 'Honolulu Zoo' IN n.filming_location RETURN n.name
MATCH (n:Movie)-[r0:hasCastMember]->(m0:Person),(n:Movie)-[r1:writtenBy]->(m0:Person) WITH DISTINCT n RETURN min(n.global_box_office_usd)
MATCH (n:Movie)-[r0:hasCastMember]->(m0:Person),(n:Movie)-[r1:writtenBy]->(m0:Person) WITH DISTINCT n WHERE n.global_box_office_usd > 70000000 RETURN n.name
MATCH (n:Person)<-[r0:hasCastMember]-(m0:Movie),(n:Person)<-[r1:writtenBy]-(m0:Movie) WITH DISTINCT n UNWIND n.country_of_citizenship AS prop RETURN DISTINCT prop
